title: Almost TQFTs via colored ribbon graphs
summary: In this paper, we introduce ribbon TQFTs via Edge Contraction/Construction Axioms of colored ribbon graphs as an extension of the 2D TQFT axioms for ribbon graphs formulated in arXiv:1508.05922. We investigate nearly Frobenius structures and Almost TQFTs defined in arXiv:1907.05470 together with ribbon TQFTs. We give a classification result for ribbon TQFTs that extends the one obtained for Frobenius algebras in arXiv:1508.05922.
